title: Ru-Tung (Elizabeth) Sun
gist: Staff profile of MERICS analyst Ru-Tung (Elizabeth) Sun, who works on a STIP-team project on military-civil fusion in China, with research on dual-use technologies, national and cybersecurity, and China's energy system.

themes.theme: MERICS research focus on military-civil fusion

insights.claim: MERICS's STIP team is running a project on military-civil fusion in China, staffed by analyst Ru-Tung (Elizabeth) Sun.
insights.speaker: MERICS
insights.so_what: Signals European think-tank attention to dual-use risk in China, which feeds into export-control and investment-screening policy.
